component.name: ValidateRokuPayTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "validatePurchase" end sub
sub validatePurchase() m.top.state = "loading"
purchaseId = TrimString(m.top.purchaseId) productCode = TrimString(m.top.productCode) if purchaseId = "" or productCode = "" fail("Missing Roku Pay purchase metadata.") return end if
session = LoadAccountSession() if session.accessToken = invalid or session.accessToken = "" fail("Sign in to your StreamShōgun account before validating this Roku Pay purchase.") return end if
response = ApiPostJson(session.apiBaseUrl, "/v1/roku/validate-purchase", { purchaseId: purchaseId, productCode: productCode }, session.accessToken)
if not response.ok savePending(productCode, purchaseId, "pending_backend_validation") fail("Backend validation did not complete. " + response.error) return end if
payload = response.json if payload = invalid or payload.entitled <> true savePending(productCode, purchaseId, "not_entitled") fail("Roku Pay did not confirm this purchase as entitled.") return end if
savePending(productCode, purchaseId, "validated")
if payload.subscription <> invalid session.plan = IIF(payload.subscription.plan <> invalid, payload.subscription.plan, "PRO") session.status = IIF(payload.subscription.status <> invalid, payload.subscription.status, "ACTIVE") session.billingInterval = IIF(payload.subscription.billingInterval <> invalid, payload.subscription.billingInterval, "") session.currentPeriodEnd = IIF(payload.subscription.currentPeriodEnd <> invalid, payload.subscription.currentPeriodEnd, "") if session.flags = invalid then session.flags = {} session.flags["epg_proxy"] = true session.flags["unlimited_playlists"] = true session.checkedAt = CreateObject("roDateTime").AsSeconds() SaveAccountSession(session) end if
m.top.result = payload m.top.state = "done" end sub
sub savePending(productCode as String, purchaseId as String, status as String) now = CreateObject("roDateTime").AsSeconds() state = LoadRokuPayState() purchasedAt = state.purchasedAt if purchasedAt = invalid or purchasedAt = 0 then purchasedAt = now SaveRokuPayState({ productCode: productCode, purchaseId: purchaseId, status: status, purchasedAt: purchasedAt, lastRestoreAt: now }) end sub
sub fail(message as String) m.top.error = message m.top.state = "error" end sub
